data.summary:
**When:** Any phase, after an enemy model that has [Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise) (not a **TITANIC** model) is **destroyed**.

**Target:** A **HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER** unit of yours that was up to 18" from that enemy model as it was destroyed.

**Effect:** Your opponent makes no roll to see whether that model's Deadly Demise inflicts mortal wounds: they are inflicted automatically. If the number of mortal wounds is random, your opponent rolls for it as normal.
